definition: A limiting stage or resource that constrains the performance or flow of a larger system.

output.text: {"associations": [{"item": "factory assembly line", "connection": "A slow-moving workstation limits the overall production rate of the entire manufacturing process."}, {"item": "internet router", "connection": "A router with limited bandwidth can restrict the speed at which data flows across an entire network."}, {"item": "blood circulation", "connection": "A narrowed artery acts as a bottleneck, reducing blood flow to vital organs."}, {"item": "software licensing system", "connection": "A limited number of licenses restricts the number of users who can access a particular software application."}, {"item": "language translation model", "connection": "A model with insufficient training data on a specific dialect can hinder accurate translations for that region."}]}
